open_release.rationale: The README motivates the synthetic records as a way for stakeholders to share data without privacy hurdles, with a membership-inference privacy assessment.

quotes.text: Synthetic records helping stakeholders to *share and work* on data without privacy hurdles

pipeline_testing.rationale: The sources make realism and privacy claims and do not mention testing software or formats.

ml_augmentation.rationale: The paper evaluates ML utility by training predictors on synthetic data and testing on real data.

quotes.text: train the predictive model on synthetic data and test it on the real data.

statistical_replication.rationale: The paper reports dimension-wise probability and statistical analysis of how realistic the synthetic records are.

quotes.text: We also give a privacy assessment and report on statistical analysis regarding realistic characteristics of the synthetic data.

causal_inference.rationale: No causal structure or intervention framing appears in the sources.

education.rationale: No teaching or tutorial framing appears in the sources.

benchmarking.rationale: The paper compares CorGAN against DBM, VAE and medGAN baselines and the repo includes baseline code, but CorGAN itself is not shown serving as a baseline for others.

imbalance_correction.rationale: No class-imbalance or minority-class framing appears in the sources.
